CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_CULT_LEADER_AUTHOR: The number of basic buff layers obtained by the apostle card is additional +1 (each layer of power). When the number of layers reaches 5, consume 5 layers to enter Elder form.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_ELDER_FORM_POWER.d: All basic buffs are automatically converted into upgraded buffs.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_LIFE_ESSENCE_POWER: Each level provides 5 points of maximum life. When actively triggered, remove 1 layer and restore 5 points of life.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_SOLID_ICE_POWER.de: Each layer increases the block obtained from the card by +1. At the end of the turn, gain blocks equal to the number of stacks. When actively triggered, 1 layer is removed, and block is obtained based on the current number of layers.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_FERVOR_POWER.title: Fanatical
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_FERVOR_POWER.descr: Each level increases the damage of the next attack card by +3 and loses 3 life points. Each trigger only consumes 1 layer.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_HAPPINESS_POWER.de: Every time you obtain 3 layers of Happiness, draw 2 cards and gain 1 energy point; triggering will not consume Happiness.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_HEALING_POWER.desc: When you take attack damage, consume stacks equal to the damage taken. Activating it consumes 1 stack. Each stack consumed restores 1 HP. Does not trigger at end of turn.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_HEALING_PER_TURN_P: At the start of your next turn, gain Healing equal to this stack count, then remove this power.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_PERSONALITY_CARD_F: At the start of your turn, move a random apostle card of the matching personality from your draw pile to your hand. Upgraded: upgrade it before moving it.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_RETAIN_POWER.title: Reserved
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_RETAIN_POWER.descr: Each stack spent lets you retain one card at end of turn.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_RETAIN_POWER.selec: Select the cards to keep (up to {Amount} cards)
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_LOOP_POWER.title: Loop
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_LOOP_POWER.descrip: Whenever you gain 1 layer of Healing, Vigor, Armor Cover, Preservation or Pain Grant, Deal {Amount} damage to all enemies.
Increase maximum health. Lost after the battle.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_TEMP_MAX_HP_LOSS_P: Maximum health reduced. Removed or restored after combat.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_HACK_MARK_POWER.de: Each time you recover life, you take damage equal to your current Healing stacks × this power's stacks. Recovery from max HP increases is also included.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_BONFIRE_VIGOR_POWE: Gain energy equal to the number of stacks at the end of the turn.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_TEMP_STRENGTH_LOSS: Restores the same amount of strength at the end of the round.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_TEMP_STRENGTH_BUFF: Loses the same amount of strength at the end of the turn.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_SAP_LAUNCHER_POWER: Each time you regenerate health, deal damage equal to the number of stacks to a random enemy.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_REMOTE_CHARGE_POWE: Each time the life is restored for a number of times equal to the number of layers, 1 point of energy is gained.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_SEBASTIAN_POWER.de: For every 5 points of life, gain 1 point of Vigor at the end of the round and cause 1 damage to a random enemy. When receiving unblocked damage, life will be consumed first to block it.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_SKY_RULER_POWER.de: Vulnerability and Weakness have twice the effect on enemies.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_MAGIC_BULLET_POWER: When playing “Magic Bullet Shooting Hand”, it will apply 1 layer of vulnerability, 1 layer of Weakness, 2 layers of Poison and 4 layers of Doom to the target.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_ON_ATTACKED_GAIN_B: Each time you are attacked, you will receive {Amount} layer of pain.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_DEBUFF_APPLY_COUNT: Every time {Amount} negative effects are applied to the enemy, 1 point of energy for the next round will be obtained.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_FRENZY_ON_HEAL_POW: Are you coming to meet the girl?
Whenever you restore 1 HP or gain 1 Healing, gain 1 Vigor; in Elder form, gain Fervor instead.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_VIGOR_PER_TURN_POW: Gain energy equal to the number of stacks at the beginning of the next turn, then remove.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_ON_ATTACKED_GAIN_P: When attacked, gain {Amount} layer of armor.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_OUT_OF_TURN_PLATIN: When armor is obtained outside the turn, draw 1 card.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_PLATING_REBOUND_DA: Whenever an enemy attacks you, it will cause damage equal to the current armor layer ×{Amount}.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_POOL_CANDIDATE_POW: Gain {Amount} layer of armor at the end of the round; gain a block equal to the current armor at the beginning of the round.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_FLAT_DAMAGE_REDUCT: While you have Block, monster attack damage about to be dealt to you is reduced by {Amount}.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_NEXT_TURN_STRENGTH: At the beginning of the enemy's next turn, the enemy loses {Amount} points of strength.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_INK_WASH_POWER.des: At the end of the turn, gain armor equal to the number of cards in your hand, then remove this effect.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_EPICON_ASSISTANT_P: At the beginning of the round, gain {Amount} layer of Healing,{Amount} layer of pain,{Amount} layer of Vigor and {Amount} layer of armor.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_FROG_RAIN_POWER.de: At the beginning of the round, gain Retain and restore 1 life point. The number of layers represents the number of rounds remaining.
Every time this enemy causes damage to you, it loses {Amount} points of strength.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_REFLECT_NEXT_DAMAG: The next time you are attacked, all damage caused by the attack will be reflected back to the attacker (including the blocked part).
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_FATE_CLOCK_POWER.d: The upper corner is the number of remaining rounds, and the lower corner is the damage value. At the beginning of the enemy's turn, the stack level is -1. When it reaches zero, it will cause damage and remove it.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_FATE_CLOCK_POWER.s: At the beginning of the enemy's turn, the stack level is -1. When it returns to zero, it will Deal {Damage} damage and be removed.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_EXTANT_POWER.title: Survival
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_EXTANT_POWER.descr: At end of turn, for each card the player retains, enemies with this effect take 3 damage per stack.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_ADJUST_POWER.title: Adjustment
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_ADJUST_POWER.descr: Whenever you gain a hold, deal damage to a random enemy, and this damage will be +3 for the rest of the battle.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_BEE_POWER.title: Zhubee
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_ABILITY_DAMAGE_TAK: Damage this enemy takes from Power cards is increased by {Amount}%.
Whenever the player deals unblocked damage to this enemy, gain 1 Gold and 1 Healing.
At the end of your turn, for each stack of Bitter Pain, randomly apply 1 Vulnerable, 1 Weak, 3 Poison, or 6 Doom to a random enemy. After all stacks trigger, Bitter Pain decreases by 1.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_BITTER_PAIN_BURST_: At the end of your turn, for each stack of Bitter Pain Burst, apply 1 Vulnerable, 1 Weak, 3 Poison, and 6 Doom to all enemies. This status does not decrease each turn.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_FORWARD_RESOLVE_PO: Whenever you trigger the set amount of Vigor, gain the set amount of Vigor.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_MOON_FIELD_POWER.d: When attacking an enemy, each stack of Moon Field adds 1 damage for each type of debuff on that enemy.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_BEE_POWER.descript: At the start of the enemy turn, for each stack, gain 1 Weak and take 5 damage, then decrease by 1.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_WALNUT_MASTER_POWE: At the end of your turn, gain Retain equal to half your current Block, then decrease by 1.
During the countdown, gain Retain at the start of each turn. When the countdown ends, deal damage to all enemies.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_DIMENSION_POSITION: After your next Attack card resolves, restore the core buff stacks it consumed, triggered, or removed.
CULT_LEADER_MOD_POWER_PERSONALITY_CARD_F: At the start of your turn, move a random Pure apostle card from your draw pile to your hand. Upgraded: upgrade it before moving it.
At the start of your turn, move a random Calm apostle card from your draw pile to your hand. Upgraded: upgrade it before moving it.
At the start of your turn, move a random Frenzy apostle card from your draw pile to your hand. Upgraded: upgrade it before moving it.
At the start of your turn, move a random Lively apostle card from your draw pile to your hand. Upgraded: upgrade it before moving it.
At the start of your turn, move a random Melancholy apostle card from your draw pile to your hand. Upgraded: upgrade it before moving it.
